content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan often face significant barriers when trying to sell their products online. Platforms such as Stripe and PayPal not only restrict access but can also suspend accounts without warning, leaving creators unable to access their funds. This comparison will explore viable alternatives to Lemon Squeezy for those in restricted countries, illustrating how sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-how-bangladeshi-freelancers-accept-international|infrastructure]] offers a robust solution for creators looking for autonomy and reliability.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy provides a user-friendly interface for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-every-detail-you-3|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-12|Selling Courses]] digital products, but it operates under substantial limitations in restricted countries. In contrast, platforms like Gumroad and Paddle offer similar functionalities but also face restrictions that exclude many creators globally. These platforms often charge substantial fees and impose rigid policies. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, enables creators to deploy their own stores using tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, ensuring they retain full control over their sales and customer data.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 worldwide, leaving a vast number of creators without access to its services. PayPal can suspend accounts for up to 180 days, locking funds without recourse. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, is designed for creators in restricted countries. It bypasses traditional barriers by providing essential tools that work seamlessly without reliance on any single platform, thus ensuring creators can operate freely regardless of their geographical location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed and fees are critical considerations for digital sellers. Platforms like PayPal and Stripe impose varying fees, often exceeding 2.9% plus fixed fees per transaction. Additionally, these platforms can have unpredictable processing times. Sovereign commerce solutions utilize NOWPayments, which charges a minimal 0.5% fee and processes payments instantly on-chain, significantly reducing costs. This efficiency allows creators to maximize their revenue and eliminate the financial burden associated with traditional payment processors.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you complete ownership, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant drawbacks of traditional platforms is the lack of true ownership over the sales process. With services like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy, creators are essentially renting access to their customer base and data. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that creators own everything after deployment. This includes full data ownership, automated payment processing, and instant product delivery through systems like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, enabling creators to build a sustainable and self-directed business model.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you're just starting and need a straightforward setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a solid option. For those looking for a more robust solution with multiple products and enhanced capabilities, the Edge Commerce Stack offers comprehensive features, including configuration for email security protocols like SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Consider your product range, desired automation level, and the importance of data ownership when selecting the architecture that suits your business best.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Traditional payment processors can suspend your account and freeze your funds with no warning.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators searching for a way to sell digital products without relying on traditional platforms, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a viable solution. You can explore deployment options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you can find the necessary tools for your sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital products without a Gumroad account?

You can utilize sovereign commerce infrastructure to create your own online store without relying on Gumroad. Tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments allow you to set up a fully functional storefront that processes payments automatically.
What are the best alternatives to PayPal for creators in restricted countries?

NOWPayments is an excellent alternative, allowing creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee. It enables instant payment processing without the need for buyer accounts, making it ideal for restricted countries.
Can I use Lemon Squeezy in my country?
Lemon Squeezy may not operate in many restricted countries where creators reside. It's crucial to evaluate local regulations and platform availability before committing to any service.
What happens if my PayPal account gets suspended?
If your PayPal account is suspended, you risk having your funds withheld for up to 180 days with no chance of appeal. This uncertainty can severely impact your business operations.
What should I consider when choosing a payment processor?

Consider transaction fees, payment speed, the reliability of fund access, and the level of data ownership provided. Sovereign commerce solutions often offer lower fees and better control over your sales.
Instant payment processing through NOWPayments allows you to focus on creating, not worrying about transactions.
